​🎯 స్టడీ టిప్స్, ట్రిక్స్ & మోటివేషన్
​✨ "నేర్చుకోవడం ఆపకండి.. ఎదగడం మానకండి!"
మీ భవిష్యత్తుకు బలమైన పునాది వేయడానికి ఇప్పుడే Subscribe చేసుకోండి! 🔔👇

snippet.title: TECH Global University
snippet.description:
Die TECH Global University ist die größte digitale Universität der Welt mit über 14.000 Programmen in 11 Sprachen und einer Beschäftigungsquote von 99%. Sie ist offiziell in Amerika (Mexiko), Europa (Andorra, Spanien) und Afrika (Tansania, Marokko) anerkannt und in über 150 Ländern präsent. Sie wurde zweimal von der Financial Times als eines der 250 am schnellsten wachsenden Unternehmen Europas ausgezeichnet.

Forbes zeichnet sie aufgrund ihrer Relearning-Methodik und der Anwendung der Harvard Case Method als die beste Online-Universität der Welt aus. Ihr Lehrkörper, auf Ivy-League-Niveau, besteht aus mehr als 6.000 Experten von führenden Unternehmen wie Google, Apple oder Nike, Krankenhäusern wie der Mayo Clinic und Teams wie den Boston Celtics. Die TECH Global University ist Google Partner Premier und hat eine Durchschnittsbewertung von 4,9/5 in über 25.000 Bewertungen.

snippet.title: Tiff's Take
snippet.description:
Tiff’s Take: Let’s Figure This Out Together.

I’m not a "YouTube Guru"—I’m a creator just like you, and I’m right here in the trenches with you.

I know the frustration of hitting your milestones only to face a "Reused Content" rejection or watching the 2026 algorithm shift toward 4K and TV screens while your views struggle. At Tiff’s Take, we’re leaving the "High-Level Tech" talk behind and heading back to the playground. I’m sharing every lesson I learn in real-time—the wins, the mistakes, and the "What the hell did I swipe into?" moments.

We’re learning, growing, and securing the bag together. No fluff, no ego—just my take on navigating this journey.

💰 Support the Journey: $tiffstake1

Be blessed. Have a blessed day. And most importantly, do what you can to bless someone else’s day.

#YouTubeGrowth #ContentCreator #SmallCreator

Tiff’s Take: Let’s Figure This Out Together.

I’m not a "YouTube Guru"—I’m a creator just like you, and I’m right here in the trenches with you.

I know the frustration of hitting your milestones only to face a "Reused Content" rejection or watching the 2026 algorithm shift toward 4K and TV screens while your views struggle. At Tiff’s Take, we’re leaving the "High-Level Tech" talk behind and heading back to the playground. I’m sharing every lesson I learn in real-time—the wins, the mistakes, and the "What the hell did I swipe into?" moments.

We’re learning, growing, and securing the bag together. No fluff, no ego—just my take on navigating this journey.

💰 Support the Journey: $tiffstake1

Be blessed. Have a blessed day. And most importantly, do what you can to bless someone else’s day.

#YouTubeGrowth #ContentCreator #SmallCreator

snippet.title: TECH Global University
snippet.description:
A TECH Global University é a maior universidade digital do mundo, oferecendo mais de 14.000 programas em 11 idiomas. Com uma taxa de empregabilidade de 99%, possui reconhecimento oficial em países como México, Costa Rica, Tanzânia, Marrocos, Andorra e Espanha.

Foi nomeada duas vezes pelo Financial Times como uma das 250 empresas de mais rápido crescimento na Europa. 

A Forbes reconheceu a TECH como “a melhor universidade digital do mundo” graças ao seu sistema de Relearning e ao uso do Método do Caso de Harvard.

Seu corpo docente — de nível Ivy League — conta com mais de 6.000 especialistas de empresas como Amazon, Google e Apple, além de profissionais de hospitais renomados como a Mayo Clinic.

A TECH também mantém parcerias com organizações esportivas de elite, incluindo o Boston Celtics.

snippet.title: Stanford Online
snippet.description:
You can gain access to a world of education through Stanford Online, the Stanford School of Engineering’s portal for academic and professional education offered by schools and units throughout Stanford University. https://online.stanford.edu/

snippet.title: PLSQL Lab Notes
snippet.description:
Hi, I'm glad you're here!

I'm the person behind PLSQL Lab Notes. I love running real Oracle SQL and PL/SQL and seeing what actually happens, including the errors that make us all scratch our heads. Then I show you the fix.

Here's what you'll find on the channel
- SQL puzzles in Shorts: can you guess the answer before the timer runs out?
- True data disaster stories: deleted databases, broken backups, and one tiny typo that took down half the internet
- Step-by-step lessons on Oracle errors, PL/SQL, JSON, Redis, DuckDB, PostgreSQL and more

Every example is run on Oracle Database Free before it goes up, so what you see on screen is the real thing. The narration is a synthetic (AI) voice and I use AI to help prepare the scripts.

Got a puzzle that fooled you, or a topic you'd like me to try next? Tell me in the comments. I read them all.

snippet.title: TECH Global University
snippet.description:
TECH Global University is the largest digital university in the world, offering over 14,000 programs in 11 languages. With a 99% employability rate, it holds official recognition in countries such as Mexico, Costa Rica, Tanzania, Morocco, Andorra, and Spain.

It has been named twice by the Financial Times as one of the 250 fastest-growing companies in Europe. 

Forbes has recognized TECH as “the best digital university in the world” for its Relearning system and the use of the Harvard Case Method.

Its faculty — at Ivy League level — includes more than 6,000 experts from companies like Amazon, Google, and Apple, as well as from renowned hospitals such as the Mayo Clinic. TECH also partners with elite sports organizations, including the Boston Celtics.

snippet.title: Aruna Techie Talks
snippet.description:
Hi — I am the person behind "The AI Shift". I'm not an AI expert, and I'm not going to pretend to be one here. What I do have is a few years of hands-on experience watching (and living through) the shift from traditional SaaS thinking into this new AI-first world — the new roles, the re worked workflows,these took me longer to untangle than they should have.
This channel exists because I wished, more than once, that someone had just laid these things out plainly instead of assuming I already knew the vocabulary. So that's what I'm trying to do here: break down AI concepts — agentic AI, generative AI, SDLC vs AIDLC, real stakeholders are on an AI team versus a SaaS team.

If you're coming from a traditional SaaS background and wondering where you fit into this shift, or just trying to make sense of the terms everyone's throwing around — that's exactly who this channel is for. I'm still learning a lot of this myself, in public, as I go. If that sounds useful, I'd love to have you along.

snippet.title: ourfuture_studio
snippet.description:
새로운 지식, 뜻밖의 연결.

어떤 이야기는 이미 알고 있던 것들을 다르게 보게 합니다. 새롭게 배운 개념 하나가 오래된 질문과 만나고, 작은 실험이 다음 아이디어의 시작이 되기도 합니다.

Our Future Studio는 AI와 기술의 원리, 인간의 사고와 기억, 직접 해보는 작은 실험을 함께 살펴보는 지식 스튜디오입니다.

하나를 깊이 들여다보고, 다른 것과 연결하며, 자신의 질문을 발견하는 시간을 만듭니다. 쉽고 정확한 설명에 근거와 출처를 더하고, 더 궁금한 내용은 글과 실습으로 이어갑니다.

정해진 답을 찾아가는 길목 너머, 이곳에서 마주친 뜻밖의 지식이 여러분의 경험과 만나 선물 같은 세렌디피티(Serendipity)로 이어지기를 바랍니다.

snippet.title: Practical Data Science
snippet.description:
Statistics and machine learning, made simple. 📊

Practical Data Science breaks down statistics and the algorithms behind modern AI — regression, decision trees, random forests, neural networks, and more — with intuition first and scary math deferred. Perfect for beginners learning statistics and machine learning from scratch, and for students who want their class topics explained step by step.

Playlists are full courses: each series starts at the beginning and builds lesson by lesson, so you can learn in order and binge a whole unit in one sitting.

📅 New lessons every other day — plus extra class units (study design, categorical data, comparing groups, simulation-based inference) on the days in between during the school year. Subscribe so each lesson lands in order.

Until then: keep practicing.

snippet.title: Podcast with Uttam and AI
snippet.description:

For e-commerce founders who are using AI to help run their business, and want to learn more about building tools and workflows. I also share the tools I'm building, and show exactly how I build them.

My name's Rich. I'm a mechanical engineer who spent 12 years as an ecommerce founder, running and growing my own stores on Shopify and Amazon as a solopreneur, and generated over 7 figures in sales across my brands.

I was doing everything myself, so out of necessity I started using AI to automate the back end, and that got me into vibe coding. Now I build AI systems instead: dashboards, apps, automations, data pipelines. Abaxar is the first one I've made available to others.

snippet.title: Talha Ahad
snippet.description:
Welcome to Talha Ahad Podcast. It was journalism that brought me back to Islamabad from London in 2016. Over the last 6 years, I have been privileged enough to meet with lots of interesting people from former PM Imran Khan, to Guantanamo Bay prisoners, to industry leaders, politicians, creatives, and all kinds of people in between. The stories they shared off-screen were far more fascinating than the ones they told on screen. 

I am Talha Ahad, an entrepreneur, journalist, and documentary filmmaker. I am going on a journey to explore who people really are beyond the face they show to the world. And have meaningful conversations about how their stories have shaped them and the way they see the world today. I hope you enjoy it.

snippet.title: Layerwise
snippet.description:
You use AI every day. Layerwise shows you how it actually works.

Every video starts from zero, with an everyday example and no background needed. Then we build up, one layer at a time, until you understand the real ideas behind tools like ChatGPT. Every animation is drawn from the actual math, so curious beginners finally get it and students and engineers get a clear visual refresher.

Season 1, Zero to AI, tells the story in order: from a 1943 idea for an artificial brain cell to the AI in your pocket today. Short, accurate, easy to follow.

New here? Start with Episode 1: How every AI learns.

Why not hit that subscribe button and join our community of curious and engaged learners? We can't wait to take this journey of exploration and discovery with you, layer by layer. Technology Demystified.
